title: MakeupMirror: Improving Facial Attribute Preservation in Diffusion Models for Makeup Transfer
title_zh: MakeupMirror：提升扩散模型在妆容迁移中的面部属性保持能力
abstract_en: Makeup transfer models enable fun augmented reality (AR) experiences as well as virtual try-on (VTO) for online makeup shopping. While recent state-of-the-art diffusion based solutions such as Stable-Makeup dramatically improve the accuracy and realism of makeup transfer, they still face limitations in identity and skin color preservation, making production-level VTO for makeup shopping unrealistic. In this work, we propose MakeupMirror, a diffusion-based approach to makeup transfer that makes significant progress towards preserving facial features and skin tone. We introduce several technical innovations over Stable-Makeup: (1) integration of facial geometry conditioning with ControlNets to maintain facial fidelity; (2) region-specific makeup transfer control to enable precise makeup application across facial regions such as skin, eyes and lips; (3) skin tone-based makeup transfer modulation that prevent skin tone alteration in cross-subject transfer scenarios; and (4) integration of a Levenberg-Marquardt Langevin sampler to speed up inference while maintaining generation quality. Our experiments on CPM-Real, Makeup Wild, and (herein newly collected, more diverse) MakeupSelfies datasets show that MakeupMirror improves relative facial recognition similarity by +60%, reduces relative skin tone difference by -50% over Stable-Makeup, with a latency of 0.7s, while achieving expert acceptance rate of 94% across core facial identity preservation criteria.
abstract_zh: MakeupMirror 是一种面向妆容迁移（makeup transfer）的 diffusion-based 方法，旨在解决现有 Stable-Makeup 等方法在身份特征与肤色保持上的不足，使其更适合 AR 与线上美妆虚拟试妆（VTO）场景。论文在 Stable-Makeup 基础上引入多项改进：使用 ControlNets 融合面部几何条件以保持面部保真度；设计分区域妆容迁移控制，实现皮肤、眼部、唇部等区域的精确上妆；提出基于肤色的妆容迁移调制，避免跨主体迁移时改变原始肤色；并集成 Levenberg-Marquardt Langevin sampler，在维持生成质量的同时加速推理。实验在 CPM-Real、Makeup Wild 以及新收集、更具多样性的 MakeupSelfies 数据集上进行。结果显示，相比 Stable-Makeup，MakeupMirror 的相对人脸识别相似度提升 60%，相对肤色差异降低 50%，推理延迟为 0.7 秒，并在核心身份保持标准上达到 94% 的专家接受率。
key_points_zh: 提出 MakeupMirror，在 diffusion-based 妆容迁移中重点提升面部身份特征与肤色保持，面向生产级 AR/VTO 美妆试妆应用。
通过 ControlNets 引入面部几何条件，增强生成结果对原始脸型、五官结构和身份特征的保真度。
设计 region-specific makeup transfer control，可分别控制皮肤、眼部、唇部等区域的妆容迁移，提升局部上妆精度。
提出 skin tone-based makeup transfer modulation，减少跨主体妆容迁移时对用户原始肤色的错误改变。
在 CPM-Real、Makeup Wild 和 MakeupSelfies 上，相比 Stable-Makeup，人脸相似度相对提升 60%，肤色差异相对降低 50%，延迟约 0.7 秒。

llm_assessment.comment: A technically useful virtual try-on paper for makeup shopping, but it is peripheral to e-commerce agents, search, recommendation, or shopping workflows.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇对美妆购物虚拟试妆有实用价值的技术论文，但与电商智能体、搜索、推荐或购物流程的关联较弱。
